actions.script:
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory def logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger("GenerativeAiServices")
logger.info("Generating AI Draft for Ticket ID: ${ticketId}")

service.description: Takes a long, multi-email thread from a Helpdesk Ticket and uses an LLM to generate a concise 3-bullet-point summary for managers.
